items.title: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
items.summary: The TV presenter says he was once "friendly" with both David Walliams and Russell Brand, but was "genuinely unaware of their conduct".

items.title: Why Walliams' unprecedented legal battle to stay anonymous failed
items.summary: The 55-year-old was named in reports by ITV News and the Guardian on Tuesday after losing a court bid to stop allegations being made public.

items.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
items.summary: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

items.title: Acquitted 'China spy': I was fall guy for security services
items.summary: Thousands of messages seen by BBC show how a Chinese official sought details of sensitive political matters.

items.title: Temperatures to dip to -5C as first cold health alerts of season issued
items.summary: The most widespread frost of the season so far is forecast for many parts of the country. BBC Weather's Tomasz Schafernaker reports.

items.title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
items.summary: The 41-year-old senior soldier is accused of national security offences and is being questioned in London.

items.title: Prince George's artwork featured in Country Life magazine
items.summary: The Prince of Wales features his 13-year-old son's drawing of a bird as part of a special edition of the magazine.

items.title: Antidepressant escitalopram more effective at preventing relapse, analysis finds
items.summary: Three pills came top and outperformed Prozac for preventing relapse in a large number of patients.
